name: Tonino Picula - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Serbia
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its view on Serbia's progress towards joining the EU. It says reforms have stalled or gone backwards on rule of law, media freedom and elections. It asks Serbia to align fully with EU foreign policy, including sanctions on Russia, and to hold genuinely free elections. It also calls on the EU Commission to be tougher, and to hold back or redirect some funding until Serbia makes real progress. This is an opinion; it does not change law.

- Serbia must meet rule-of-law and election standards before talks advance; EU funding to its government should be suspended.
- It affects Serbia's government, media, judiciary, minorities and citizens, plus EU institutions managing aid.
- Next, the Commission and EU governments respond; Serbia decides whether to act on the demands.
